verdict.rationale: Nothing in the pack documents private networking, internal-only service endpoints, or a way to keep service-to-service traffic off the public internet. Deployment Protection (Vercel Authentication, passwords, trusted IPs) and identity-provider access only gate who can reach public URLs; they do not keep traffic private. Community feedback says secure database connectivity beyond a password requires Enterprise sales, which also does not show a documented capability.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can keep internal service-to-service traffic off the public internet without VPC complexity
